items.summary: Developed and delivered web applications and software solutions based on client requirements, working independently.

bullets.text: Maintained and troubleshot an existing PHP application backed by MySQL, supporting internal business operations.
Investigated application issues and helped maintain existing functionality within an established codebase.
Worked with existing data retrieval functionality for customer, sales, inventory and engineering project information.
Supported internal workflows that allowed employees and engineering staff to consult operational information.
Resolved routine application issues and performed maintenance tasks within the existing system.
Collaborated with a senior developer on more significant modifications and technical issues.

items.summary: Worked on website improvements and troubleshooting, focusing on frontend issues, responsive layouts, SEO-related improvements and JavaScript-based API integration prototypes.

bullets.text: Fixed layout, spacing and styling issues to improve website consistency across different screen sizes.
Identified and resolved frontend bugs in existing websites, addressing visual and responsive behavior issues.
Implemented SEO-related improvements to support website optimization.
Built a JavaScript-based landing page prototype that consumed an external API and displayed the returned data.
Developed standalone code examples to demonstrate how API functionality could be implemented in an existing application.
